exercises.why: «The preposition В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place… Я был там в 1958-ом году.» (L.73, p. 43) «In compound ordinal numerals only the last element is actually an ordinal, and only this element is declined.» (L.72, p. 37) — DLI Grammar Reference Book.
